verdicts.explanation: The paper states that Na3.4Hf0.8Zr0.8In0.3Ga0.1(SiO4)2(PO4) has a room-temperature total conductivity of 0.7 mS/cm with activation energy 0.34 eV, listed before the 0.3 mS/cm / 0.33 eV pair. Sintering is stated only for all samples together, so null is appropriate.

The paper gives bulk conductivities of 3.96 and 3.17 mS/cm for the two compositions in order, and the conclusion confirms 3.96 mS/cm bulk for Na3.4Hf0.8Zr0.8In0.3Ga0.1(SiO4)2(PO4). No bulk activation energy is given, so null is correct.
The second composition in the sentence, Na3.5Hf1.5In0.4Ga0.1(SiO4)2(PO4), has total conductivity 0.3 mS/cm at room temperature and activation energy 0.33 eV, as stated in the paper's text.
The paper reports bulk conductivity 3.17 mS/cm for the second composition, Na3.5Hf1.5In0.4Ga0.1(SiO4)2(PO4), in the same sentence order as the total-conductivity values.

field_errors.evidence: However, the third sample, Na3.5Hf0.7In1.2Ge0.1(SiO4)1.3(PO4)1.7, is also very near the high conductivity domain and yielded only 0.01 mS/cm total ionic conductivity.

verdicts.explanation: The 0.01 mS/cm value for Na3.5Hf0.7In1.2Ge0.1(SiO4)1.3(PO4)1.7 is correct, but the paper gives no temperature for this sentence. The room-temperature context in the record comes from the other two compositions, so the temperature is not supported.
